value.rationale: This is a natural and mathematically motivated refinement of a newly proven sharp convex-geometric inequality: a complete finite-dimensional extremal law on all Cartesian product bodies with explicit equality class, plus a sharp high-dimensional polynomial penalty and leading constant depending only on factor proportions, index, and number of factors. It quantifies how nonsimplex macroscopic factorization destroys the global simplex equality, distinguishes two from three factors by decay exponents, and provides a reference asymptotic benchmark. It is not a generic small numerical update, arbitrary slice, or relabeled known table; prior hypergeometric collision exponent is credited.
